question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 9(1)/(2) years at the rate of 5.9% per annum is ₹6,726. What will be the amount payable on the same sum at the rate of 5.6% per annum simple interest in 3(1)/(7) years?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest = 6726

Time = 9(1)/(2) years

Rate = 5.9% per annum

New rate = 5.6% per annum

New time = 3(1)/(7) years

**Formula Used:**

Simple interest = Principal × Rate × Time ÷ 100

Amount = Principal + Simple interest
